title: How hacked civilian cameras became war tools, as Israel tapped Iranian traffic cameras before Khamenei's killing and Iran-linked groups hit 250+ Israeli cameras (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: How hacked civilian cameras became war tools, as Israel tapped Iranian traffic cameras before Khamenei's killing and Iran-linked groups hit 250+ Israeli cameras — The highly vulnerable devices have turned into tools for combatants to track, surveil and attack the enemy
